CANONICAL REQUIREMENTS

Accessibility contract
Run component QA →
NATIVE SEMANTICS

Expose declared range or group semantics with keyboard alternatives for every pointer/touch gesture.

KEYBOARD

Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown

FOCUS

Focusable Operable Handle, Multi Handle Order, Visible Focus

WCAG REFERENCES

1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.4.7, 2.5.1, 2.5.7, 2.5.8, 4.1.2

These requirements come from the canonical Angle Slider catalog entry. Application copy, labels, custom styling, and composed workflows still require product-level testing.

CANONICAL REQUIREMENTS

Accessibility contract
Run component QA →
NATIVE SEMANTICS

Expose structured locale-aware segments, grids, or channels rather than display-string identity.

KEYBOARD

Tab, Shift+Tab, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Enter, Escape

FOCUS

Segment Focus, Grid Focus Repair, Restore Focus

WCAG REFERENCES

1.3.1, 2.1.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 3.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2, 4.1.3

These requirements come from the canonical Color Picker catalog entry. Application copy, labels, custom styling, and composed workflows still require product-level testing.
documentation.usageCode:
import {
  ColorPickerRoot,
  ColorPickerLabel,
  ColorPickerControl,
  ColorPickerTrigger,
  ColorPickerPositioner,
  ColorPickerContent,
  ColorPickerArea,
  ColorPickerAreaThumb,
  ColorPickerChannelSlider,
  ColorPickerChannelInput,
  ColorPickerSwatch,
  ColorPickerHiddenInput,
} from '@uifn/components-react/color-picker'
import '@uifn/components/styles.css'

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ColorPickerRoot name="brand-color" defaultValue="#635bff" alpha messages={{"channels":{"r":"Red","g":"Green","b":"Blue","alpha":"Alpha"}}}>
      <ColorPickerLabel>Brand color</ColorPickerLabel>
      <ColorPickerControl>
        <ColorPickerTrigger type="button">Choose color</ColorPickerTrigger>
        <ColorPickerSwatch />
      </ColorPickerControl>
      <ColorPickerPositioner>
        <ColorPickerContent>
          <ColorPickerArea>
            <ColorPickerAreaThumb />
          </ColorPickerArea>
          <ColorPickerChannelSlider value="r" />
          <ColorPickerChannelInput value="r" />
        </ColorPickerContent>
      </ColorPickerPositioner>
      <ColorPickerHiddenInput />
    </ColorPickerRoot>
  )
}

<script lang="ts">
  import {
    AngleSliderRoot,
    AngleSliderTrack,
    AngleSliderThumb,
    AngleSliderValueText,
    AngleSliderHiddenInput,
  } from '@uifn/components-svelte/angle-slider'

<AngleSliderRoot defaultValue={225} min={0} max={360} step={1} name="rotation">

  <AngleSliderThumb />

  <AngleSliderHiddenInput />
</AngleSliderRoot>
